items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: we continued right on with Columbia with Billie singing, these small all-star bands, and you did bass, and John Kirby did bass

ctx.x: That's right -- now that's where I tie in with you -- in 1936, I came to New York to the Cotton Club with Cab Calloway, and you were with Goodman, and you had a contract to do a record with Billie Holiday.

Right, the Holiday session started, and John Hammond set those up with Brunswick Records in 1935, and then when Brunswick went out of business, it concentrated on bowling and billiard balls, the stock was sold to Columbia, and we continued right on with Columbia with Billie singing, these small all-star bands, and you did bass, and John Kirby did bass, and --
Right -- whoever was in town, eh?
